propositions: AcliClient.search_issues caches both positive and negative JQL results indefinitely with no TTL or invalidation, causing stale answers on repeat queries within a client lifetime
External code reaches into the private _search_cache attribute to manually evict entries before retries, violating encapsulation and leaving the freshness invariant undocumented and unenforced

The cache must support per-pass client lifetime (one reconcile pass per AcliClient instance in production) and provide a public invalidate_search_cache(jql=None) method to replace manual reach-in patterns
Negative results cached without a freshness door caused bug d30c where an index-visibility poll's constant JQLs returned stale empty answers on retry
Both access_check.py and test_reconcile_live_e2e.py _fresh_search must migrate from private _search_cache.pop() calls to the new public invalidation method
